reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: i bought like 3 of these already and they are an absulute game changer for skin prep before makeup, they sooth my breakouts like magic and make my skin feel smooth and hydrated ready for makeup.
reviews.zh: 我已經買咗3盒呢啲，佢哋絕對係化妝前皮膚準備嘅 game changer，佢好似魔法咁舒緩我嘅暗瘡，塊面變得滑同保濕，準備好化妝。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: Permanent in my skin care rotation. It can be used as a two for one toner plus makeup remover. It is gentle and does not irritate my skin and helps moisturize in prep of other skin care ingredients. I use it daily in the morning and night.
reviews.zh: 我護膚程序入面永遠有佢。佢可以一物兩用——爽膚水加卸妝。佢溫和，唔會刺激我嘅皮膚，仲有助保濕，為之後嘅護膚成分做好準備。我日日早晚都用。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: I really love this pad so.. much. I got skin infections and I really didn't know what to do with my infections skin so I try to put the pad on it and seems like it calm my infections skin when the pad on it. Hopefully this pad will help to heal my skin in few days.
reviews.zh: 我真係超級超級鍾意呢塊 pad。我皮膚發炎，之前真係唔知點處理好，於是試住敷塊 pad 喺上面，敷住嗰陣好似有紓緩到我發炎嘅皮膚。希望幾日之後呢塊 pad 可以幫到我塊皮膚復原。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: There has to been some kind of magic in these, I use them every morning on my cheeks bc they tend to get dryer compared to other parts of my face and I also use them on troubled areas as well and I keep it on for 3-5 min and I have noticed my skin actually glowing and my makeup looking better than ever. Would recommend ❤️
reviews.zh: 呢啲入面一定要有啲魔法，我每朝都會用喺面珠，因為佢哋比起其他位置更加容易乾燥，喺有問題嘅位置我都會敷，敷 3 至 5 分鐘左右，發覺皮膚真係有光澤，妝感亦比之前更加好。推薦 ❤️

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: I love this product's liquid toner version, which made me try these toner pads, and they did not disappoint. I love how refreshing and moisturizing these pads are. I love the texture and the material used. It looks and feels so classy. I also appreciate the tweezer that comes with it. It does not irritate at all. I can just leave it on my skin while doing other things. I will definitely repurchase it in the future.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意佢嘅液態爽膚水版本，所以先試呢款爽膚棉，用落都冇令我失望。塊棉好清爽又保濕，質地同用料我都好鍾意，望落同摸落都好有高級感。附送嘅鉗子我亦都好滿意。完全唔會刺激皮膚，我可以敷住佢做其他嘢。日後一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: I restocked on the toner pads because they don’t irritate my skin and clean all the particles and makeup that my makeup remover didn’t get the first time. It’s very similar to the dokdo toner
reviews.zh: 我回購咗呢款爽膚棉，因為佢唔會刺激皮膚，仲可以清走卸妝水第一次清唔到嘅污垢同妝容。佢同 dokdo 爽膚水好相似。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text: This toner pad contains PHA which is an exfoliating acid but it still works amazingly for my sensitive skin. It doesn’t burn, only if I use it too often. The pad itself has a smooth side (for sheet masking) and a rough side (for scrubbing) and the container doesn’t have any remaining essence. Even though it’s calming it can still be quite harsh if overused and it’s the strongest product from the whole dokdo line I would say.
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚棉含有 PHA，係一種可以去角質嘅酸，但對我嘅敏感肌嚟講仍然效果極好。佢唔會有刺痛感，只係用得太頻密先會。塊棉本身有一面係光滑嘅（用嚟做 mask），另一面係粗糙嘅（用嚟磨砂），盒入面完全冇剩餘嘅精華。雖然佢有舒緩作用，但如果用過量其實都可以好刺激，可以話係成個 dokdo 系列入面最強嘅產品。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Pad Special Set (70 + 10 Sheets)
reviews.text:
i have very sensitive skin
after using this, my skin has been calmed and relief.
i can use this as pack and leave for 5mins take it off, 
it reduces my redness skin and keep cool for 30 mins
even, in the morning, i feel watery in my skin
reviews.zh:
我皮膚好敏感
用完之後，皮膚有被鎮靜同舒緩到。
我可以用佢嚟做 pack，敷 5 分鐘再撕走，
佢減低咗我皮膚嘅泛紅，而且keep住涼感 30 分鐘
到咗第二朝，我仲覺得皮膚有水分
